inputs.name: hand over from Model Evaluation Harness to Model Registry

output.level_0: The harness crashes before writing results, so the registry stays empty and stale.
output.level_1: No link exists between the evaluation harness and the model registry today.
output.level_2: A data engineer copies evaluation scores into the registry by hand each week.
output.level_3: The harness pushes validated models to the registry automatically after each weekly retrain.
output.level_4: Every model handover is logged, signed off, and auditable for compliance and finance.
